# apt's error class of each refusal in verdicts-old.txt, the same rows and
# columns: "-" where apt accepted the shape; where it refused it, split
# (apt's own checks of the file refused it before its verifier ran),
# nodata (the verifier found no signature data: gpgv's NODATA), badsig
# (a signature failed its check: gpgv's BADSIG, sqv's "Message has been
# manipulated") or other (anything else the verifier said). Measured
# 2026-11-05 17:43 UTC with verdicts-old.txt; e2e/apt-oracle/README.md,
# "Error classes", says how each is derived.
